macro_context.market_sentiment: Risk-off on May 4, 2026: Dow -0.98%, S&P 500 and Nasdaq -~0.5%, Russell 2000 -0.76%. UAE intercepted Iranian missiles and Iran threatened to block the Strait of Hormuz, driving a flight to safety. WTI crude surged 4%+ above $106/bbl, Brent above $114. Market had rallied strongly through May 1 on Apple earnings beat and peace hopes, but Iran tensions reversed the mood sharply. Source: TheStreet, Yahoo Finance, 247WallSt.
macro_context.fed_outlook: FOMC held rates at 3.5%-3.75% on April 29, 2026 in an 8-4 split decision — the most dissent since October 1992. One dissenter (Miran) wanted a cut; three others (Hammack, Kashkari, Logan) opposed an easing bias in the statement. Fed cited elevated inflation from energy prices and Middle East uncertainty as reasons to hold. This was Powell's final meeting as Chair; he will remain on the board. Next cut timing is highly uncertain given energy-driven inflation spike. Source: CNBC, Federal Reserve, Al Jazeera.
macro_context.geopolitical: US-Iran military conflict is the dominant risk: Strait of Hormuz closure fears have driven crude oil to multi-year highs, threatening stagflationary pressure. Trump suspended Iran attacks for two weeks (causing brief relief rally), but UAE missile intercept on May 4 re-ignited fears. Additional flashpoints: Venezuela/Western Hemisphere tensions, NATO posture in Greenland. IMF downgraded global growth outlook in April 2026 citing war and energy shock. Source: IMF, Morgan Stanley, Lazard, J.P. Morgan Private Bank.

web_context.competitor_activity: JPMorgan remains the dominant peer by market cap and deposit growth (deposits +7% YoY to $2.6T vs BAC's +3% to $2.02T; JPM loans +11% vs BAC +9%). Citi is the relative outperformer YTD in stock price. Wells Fargo is the clear laggard (-8% YTD). All four major banks (JPM, BAC, WFC, C) are exploring a joint stablecoin project, which could reshape digital payments competitive dynamics. Private credit exposure is a sector-wide focus: Citi disclosed $22B in corporate private credit with zero losses; Wells disclosed 17% software collateral exposure in its $36B corporate debt book. BAC's private credit exposure details not separately disclosed. Digital banking is a key deposit driver — JPM has 63M active mobile customers (+7% YoY); BAC's comparable metric not in search results. Sources: Motley Fool, PYMNTS, CryptoBriefing, Entrepreneur.
